name: Base44 Superagents
summary: Base44 Superagents should get a cautious T1 public-surface pass focused on visible claims, access friction, pricing clarity, and proof depth.

claims.claim: Homepage loads without login and value proposition is visible
claims.evidence: Base44 is the AI-powered platform that lets users build fully functioning apps in minutes.

claims.claim: Primary agent capability is stated in concrete, testable terms
claims.evidence: Your Superagent can do the work of a personal assistant, support rep, marketing team, analyst - all the help you’ve ever needed.

claims.claim: Pricing or free/trial path is publicly discoverable
claims.evidence: Start for free. Upgrade when you're ready.

claims.claim: Core workflow can be inspected from public docs, demo, templates, or repository
claims.evidence: Explore practical, ready-to-use apps from our community of builders and make them your own.

claims.claim: Trust, privacy, or data-handling claims are findable from public navigation
claims.evidence: "Secure by default: Permissions-based and sandboxed. Your Superagent only accesses what you explicitly allow."

claims.claim: Competitor/differentiation claim is specific enough to verify
Public surface exposes at least one realistic scenario for the review engine
claims.evidence: “Scan my inbox overnight. Flag anything urgent, draft replies to the easy ones, and send me a WhatsApp summary at 7am with what you handled and what still needs me”
